text: where is that compiled_world.zig file u mentioned earlier?
resolution: Checked the current tree and git history for compiled_world.zig. framework/world/compiled_world.zig is no longer present; it was added in 35a1923ae as the duplicate 345-line renderer and deleted in ea5c673e2 when the embed was converted to the shared WorldLoader primitive. The only current compiled-world-named file is framework/v8_bindings_compiled_world.zig, which is the binding adapter, not the deleted renderer.
